name: pq-readiness-platform
description: Post-Quantum Security Assessment Platform for Institutions

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "SCANNER,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,blue,green" "npm run dev:scanner" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run prisma:migrate
